{{Quote|For five months, we've laid siege to ''Saleucami''. We Jedi have led the Republic's clone army against a ''Morgukai'' clone army created by the ''C.I.S.'' and trained by the ''Anzati''. The siege has prevented the Separatist forces from leaving Saleucami, but the cost in lives has been high, and supplies are thin.|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]|<ref name="Republic 74" />}}
One of the last campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the '''Siege of Saleucami''', also known as the '''Battle of Saleucami''', was a series of battles fought between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and thousands of specially bred [[Morgukai]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], who were trained for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and supported by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

==The siege==
{{Quote|I will be in overall command of the Republic forces. I want you as my second in command, Master Vos. Your knowledge of both Morgukai and Anzati will be invaluable.|[[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], to [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]|<ref name="Republic 73" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Saleucami.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[K'Kruhk]], [[Ausar Auset]], [[Sian Jeisel]] and [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] fight the [[Morgukai]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]]]
Having besieged the main citadel and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] citadel of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] for five [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Army made several attempts at reaching the perimeter shield generator, so that it could be deactivated and the underground [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] factories could be subjected to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. However, all attacks were met with fierce resistance from the [[Morgukai]] [[Morgukai Shadow Army|clone army]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] aiding them.<ref name="Republic 74" />

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] dug a massive trench around the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] positions. Finally establishing strongholds on the rim of the caldera, the armies were subjected to a massive attack by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces. This was but a diversion, as the real target was [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], who conducted his forces with the help of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] and was thus a primary factor in their successes.<ref name="Republic 74" />

Sending [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to kill Rancisis, [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] ended his threat, as the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] let his guard down after killing all the assassins, thus enabling Bulq to stab him from behind.<ref name="Republic 75" /> Following his [[Death/Legends|death]], the double-agent [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], Rancisis' second-in-command at the time, took over his duties.<ref name="Republic 76" />

[[File:PIE_6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces engage in the [[City/Legends|city]]]]
While the siege had lasted for months, Jedi Master [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] had been busy subverting the Separatist cloning efforts by sabotaging facilities and destroying unfinished clones.<ref name="Republic 73" /><ref name="Republic 74" /> At the climax of the battle, both he and General [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] helped Vos, his former [[Padawan/Legends|student]], escape the clutches of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and end the terror wrought by Bulq. Quinlan killed the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and escaped with his colleagues, just as the Separatist citadel was razed by Republic orbital bombardment.<ref name="Republic 77" />

With the clone facilities destroyed and the Confederate dominance of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] ended, the main battle was over. The reports of Saleucami's fall came in shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|After you have brought these reinforcements to Aayla on Felucia, you are to proceed directly to Saleucami to quell the remains of an uprising.''"<br />"''I thought Aayla and Quinlan just left Saleucami?''"<br />"''They did, but the mission was not complete.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]|<ref name="RoF" />}}
[[File:BARCspeeder_DB.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] and [[CT-3423]] prepare to fire on [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]]]
After the end of hostilities, most of the Jedi Generals moved on to other battlegrounds, leaving the remaining Separatist forces to be scoured from the planet by [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]].<ref name="RoF" />

During the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Allie was in command of a small force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]], which had stayed behind following the Republic's recent victory on the world. The desert plains were strewn with battle debris, and [[Carrion bird/Legends|carrion birds]] feasted on the fallen bodies of clone troopers.<ref name="RotS" />

When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted, Allie was identified as an enemy of the Republic. Carrying out the order, Neyo hit the brakes on his [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]], falling in behind the Jedi. He and his [[CT-3423|wingman]] opened fire with their speeder-mounted [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], killing Allie and destroying her speeder bike.<ref name="RotS" />
